desc: Read input: N, array A, array B, K, and the K queries.
Sort arrays A and B, and compute prefix sums for both sorted arrays.
For each query (X, Y), extract the first X elements of sorted A and first Y elements of sorted B.
For each A_i in the first X elements, use binary search to find the split point in the first Y elements of B, then use prefix sums to compute the sum of absolute differences efficiently.
Sum up the contributions for all A_i to get the answer for the query.
Print all K answers, each on a new line.
Implement the two-pointer approach for each query.
Use fast I/O to handle large input/output.
